guards.situation: The customer presses the system Back button or swipes back on the thank-you page; they must not fall back into the payment screen or onto an empty stack (app closed / "restart the app"), they are always sent to Reservations and the reservation list is refreshed.

guards.customer_sees: Back always lands on the Reservations tab; the X in the top-right corner (:644-655) does the same.
v2_where: lib/features/payment/payment_confirmation_screen.dart:303 (the v2 view is the child of the same BackButtonListener/PopScope); lib/features/payment/v2/confirmation_view_v2.dart:94 onClose -> close(); mg_state_screen.dart:136-142 X button calls onClose
guards.verdict_evidence: The back lock is built around both looks (MgV2.on branch sits inside the PopScope), and the v2 X button and the secondary dock button call the very same close() callback.
